response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains (e.g., web, mobile, embedded systems, AI-agent infrastructure) but lacks direct experience in C++ on Windows platforms, SQL Server/Oracle, or domain expertise in Fixed Income/Capital Markets. While the resume highlights strong generalist programming skills and leadership, it does not align with the mandatory technical or domain-specific requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong generalist programming skills across multiple languages and domains
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly
Experience with CI/CD, testing, and software craftsmanship practices
concerns: No demonstrated experience with C++ on Windows platforms (mandatory requirement)
No experience with SQL Server or Oracle (mandatory requirement)
No domain expertise in Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking

key_factors.factor: Domain expertise in Fixed Income/Capital Markets
